summary: Screen texts are clearer and accurate; nothing behaves differently.

fixes.title: Approval texts say what really happens
fixes.text: The Approvals page says a SuperAdmin can allow self-approval. Approve all says each held policy change set is approved for its exact plan only.

fixes.title: Break-glass list explains its effect
fixes.text: The Break-glass list says it exempts an account from every revoke, disable and offboard action.

fixes.title: Plain names in Settings and guards
fixes.text: Settings and guard names show plain names instead of internal ids and reference numbers.

fixes.title: Smaller text improvements
fixes.text: The Drift note explains what the stray-object sweep finds, the Community vs Pro page says permission templates are imported in the portal, and the Entra roles pack is named PIM Manager reference set.
